recipes.name: Classic Bruschetta
recipes.description: Toasted sourdough topped with fresh tomatoes, basil, garlic, and a drizzle of olive oil. A timeless Italian appetizer.

steps.description: Dice the tomatoes and finely chop the fresh basil. Mince the garlic cloves.
In a bowl, combine the diced tomatoes, basil, minced garlic, olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Toss gently and let sit for 5 minutes.
Slice the sourdough bread into 1/2-inch thick rounds. Brush lightly with olive oil and toast under the broiler for 2-3 minutes until golden.
Spoon the tomato mixture onto each toasted bread slice. Drizzle with balsamic glaze and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Stuffed Cremini Mushrooms
recipes.description: Cremini mushroom caps filled with cream cheese, garlic, and parmesan, then baked until golden and bubbly.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 375°F. Clean the cremini mushrooms and carefully remove the stems. Finely chop the stems.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Sauté the chopped stems and minced garlic for 3-4 minutes until softened.
In a bowl, combine the sautéed mixture with cream cheese and grated parmesan. Season with salt and pepper.
Fill each mushroom cap generously with the cream cheese mixture. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes until tops are golden.
Let cool for 2 minutes before serving. Garnish with fresh thyme if desired.

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
recipes.description: Fresh mozzarella, ripe tomatoes, and basil layered with olive oil and balsamic glaze. A simple and elegant Italian starter.

steps.description: Slice the fresh mozzarella and tomatoes into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
Alternate slices of mozzarella and tomato on a serving platter, overlapping slightly.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the mozzarella and tomato slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze. Season with salt and black pepper. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Gazpacho
recipes.description: A chilled Spanish soup made with ripe tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, and garlic. Refreshing and perfect for warm weather.

steps.description: Roughly chop the tomatoes, cucumber, red bell pepper, and red onion.
Place the chopped vegetables in a blender along with garlic, olive oil, and salt. Blend until smooth.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and black pepper. Transfer to a bowl, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Ladle into bowls and drizzle with a little olive oil. Garnish with diced cucumber if desired.

recipes.name: Shrimp Cocktail
recipes.description: Chilled poached shrimp served with a tangy cocktail sauce made from tomato, lemon, and garlic. A classic elegant starter.

steps.description: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes until pink and opaque. Drain and transfer to an ice bath.
In a small bowl, combine the marinara sauce with lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Mix well.
Drain the chilled shrimp and pat dry with paper towels. Arrange on a serving platter over ice.
Place the cocktail sauce in a small bowl in the center of the platter. Garnish with lemon wedges and serve.

recipes.name: Hummus Platter
recipes.description: Creamy hummus served with fresh vegetables and crackers for dipping. An easy and crowd-pleasing appetizer.

steps.description: Wash and cut the carrots, celery, and cucumber into sticks. Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Spread the hummus in a shallow bowl or plate, creating a well in the center.
Drizzle olive oil into the well and sprinkle with paprika for color.
Arrange the vegetable sticks and crackers around the hummus. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Spinach and Cream Cheese Dip
recipes.description: A warm, creamy dip of baby spinach, cream cheese, and parmesan. Perfect for scooping with crackers or bread.

steps.description: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Lightly grease a small baking dish.
Heat olive oil in a skillet. Add minced garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add baby spinach and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes. Drain excess liquid.
In a bowl, combine the wilted spinach with cream cheese, sour cream, and grated parmesan. Season with salt and pepper.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish. Bake for 18-20 minutes until bubbly and lightly golden on top.
Let cool for 3 minutes. Serve warm with crackers or sliced bread for dipping.

recipes.name: Deviled Eggs
recipes.description: Hard-boiled eggs halved and filled with a creamy, tangy yolk mixture seasoned with mustard and paprika.

steps.description: Place the eggs in a pot and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then turn off heat, cover, and let sit for 12 minutes. Transfer to an ice bath.
Peel the cooled eggs and slice in half lengthwise. Gently remove the yolks and place them in a bowl.
Mash the yolks with a fork. Add the Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper. Mix until smooth and creamy.
Spoon or pipe the yolk mixture back into the egg white halves. Sprinkle with paprika and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Chicken Satay Skewers
recipes.description: Marinated chicken strips grilled on skewers with a savory peanut dipping sauce. A Thai-inspired crowd favorite.

steps.description: Cut the chicken breast into thin strips. In a bowl, combine soy sauce, sesame oil, fresh ginger, and garlic. Add chicken strips and marinate for 15 minutes.
Thread the marinated chicken strips onto wooden skewers that have been soaked in water.
In a small bowl, whisk together peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, and a splash of warm water until smooth.
Grill or pan-sear the chicken skewers over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Arrange the skewers on a platter and serve with the peanut dipping sauce on the side.

recipes.name: Cucumber Cream Cheese Bites
recipes.description: Crisp cucumber rounds topped with herbed cream cheese, smoked salmon, and capers. Light and elegant finger food.

steps.description: Slice the cucumber into 1/4-inch thick rounds. Pat dry with paper towels.
In a bowl, mix the cream cheese with finely chopped dill and a pinch of black pepper until smooth.
Spread a small amount of the herbed cream cheese onto each cucumber round. Top with a small piece of smoked salmon.
Place a few capers on each bite and serve on a platter.

recipes.name: Classic Guacamole
recipes.description: Fresh avocado mashed with lime, cilantro, onion, and tomato. Served with tortilla chips for dipping.

steps.description: Halve the avocados, remove pits, and scoop the flesh into a bowl. Mash with a fork to desired consistency.
Finely dice the red onion and cherry tomatoes. Chop the fresh cilantro.
Add the diced onion, tomatoes, cilantro, and lime juice to the mashed avocado. Season with salt and mix gently.
Transfer to a serving bowl and serve immediately with tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Corn Chowder
recipes.description: A creamy, comforting soup with sweet corn, potatoes, and a touch of cream. Hearty enough as a starter or light meal.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add diced yellow onion, garlic, and celery. Cook for 4-5 minutes until softened.
Add the vegetable broth and corn kernels. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to partially blend the soup, leaving some chunks for texture.
Stir in the heavy cream and season with salt and black pepper. Simmer for 3 more minutes.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh thyme if desired.

recipes.name: Miso Ginger Soup
recipes.description: A light and savory Japanese-inspired soup with miso, fresh ginger, mushrooms, and spinach.

steps.description: Bring the vegetable broth to a gentle simmer in a pot over medium heat.
Add the grated fresh ginger and sliced cremini mushrooms. Simmer for 5 minutes until mushrooms are tender.
Add the baby spinach and stir until wilted, about 1 minute.
Remove from heat. Stir in the soy sauce and sesame oil. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Ladle into bowls and serve immediately while hot.

recipes.name: Black Bean and Corn Salsa
recipes.description: A colorful and zesty salsa with black beans, corn, tomatoes, cilantro, and lime. Served with tortilla chips.

steps.description: Drain and rinse the black beans. Dice the cherry tomatoes and finely dice the red onion. Chop the fresh cilantro.
In a large bowl, combine the black beans, corn kernels, diced tomatoes, red onion, and cilantro.
Squeeze the lime juice over the mixture. Add salt and ground cumin. Toss gently to combine.
Let sit for 10 minutes for flavors to meld. Serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Crostini
recipes.description: Toasted sourdough rounds topped with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers, and fresh dill. An elegant party appetizer.

steps.description: Slice the sourdough bread into thin rounds. Brush lightly with olive oil and toast in the oven at 375°F for 4-5 minutes until crisp.
Let the crostini cool slightly. Spread a thin layer of cream cheese on each round.
Drape a small piece of smoked salmon on top of each crostini.
Top each crostini with a few capers and a sprig of fresh dill. Arrange on a platter and serve.

recipes.name: Baked Brie with Honey and Almonds
recipes.description: Warm, melty brie cheese baked with honey and toasted almonds. Served with crackers for an indulgent starter.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream cheese round on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Drizzle the honey over the top of the cheese. Scatter the almonds over the honey.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until the cheese is soft and slightly melted but still holds its shape.
Transfer carefully to a serving plate. Surround with crackers and serve immediately while warm.

recipes.name: Greek Feta and Olive Dip
recipes.description: A Mediterranean dip of whipped feta cheese with kalamata olives, olive oil, and a squeeze of lemon. Bold and tangy.

steps.description: Place the feta cheese, Greek yogurt, and olive oil in a food processor. Blend until smooth and creamy.
Roughly chop the kalamata olives and fold them into the whipped feta mixture.
Add lemon juice and black pepper. Stir to combine. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Transfer to a bowl, drizzle with a little olive oil, and serve with crackers or vegetable sticks.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Bites with Sour Cream
recipes.description: Roasted sweet potato rounds topped with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of paprika. Simple and satisfying.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 400°F. Peel the sweet potatoes and slice into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
Toss the sweet potato rounds with olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet. Roast for 18-20 minutes, flipping once.
Remove from oven and let cool slightly. Place a small dollop of sour cream on each round.
Sprinkle with paprika and serve warm as finger food.

recipes.name: Garlic Parmesan Asparagus Spears
recipes.description: Roasted asparagus spears tossed in garlic and olive oil, finished with shaved parmesan. A quick and elegant appetizer.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 425°F. Trim the woody ends from the asparagus spears.
Toss the asparagus with olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet.
Spread in a single layer and roast for 10-12 minutes until tender-crisp and lightly browned at the tips.
Transfer to a serving platter and shave parmesan cheese over the top. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Tomato Basil Soup
recipes.description: A velvety smooth tomato soup infused with fresh basil and a touch of cream. A comforting classic starter.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Add diced yellow onion and minced garlic. Cook for 4-5 minutes until softened.
Add the chopped tomatoes and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the fresh basil leaves. Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until completely smooth.
Stir in the heavy cream and season with salt and black pepper. Simmer gently for 3 more minutes.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with a fresh basil leaf. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and bell pepper sauce. A hearty one-pan breakfast with North African roots.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add diced onion, bell pepper, and garlic. Cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Add diced tomatoes, cumin, and paprika. Season with salt and pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Make 4 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook for 5-7 minutes until whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Remove from heat, top with crumbled feta and fresh cilantro. Serve directly from the skillet with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Huevos Rancheros
recipes.description: Crispy corn tortillas topped with fried eggs, black beans, and a zesty tomato salsa. A satisfying Mexican-inspired breakfast.

steps.description: Dice tomatoes and combine with minced garlic, chopped cilantro, lime juice, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Heat corn tortillas in a dry skillet until lightly crisped on both sides. Set aside on plates.
Heat olive oil in the skillet and fry eggs sunny-side up. Meanwhile warm black beans in a small saucepan with cumin.
Place tortillas on plates, top with black beans, fried eggs, and fresh salsa. Add sour cream and cilantro.

recipes.name: Breakfast Burrito
recipes.description: A flour tortilla stuffed with scrambled eggs, black beans, cheddar cheese, and fresh salsa. A grab-and-go morning powerhouse.

steps.description: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Cook in a buttered skillet over medium heat, stirring gently until just set.
Heat black beans in a small saucepan. Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Lay tortillas flat. Layer scrambled eggs, black beans, shredded cheddar, and diced avocado down the center.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Slice in half on the diagonal and serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Veggie Frittata
recipes.description: An Italian-style open-faced omelette loaded with bell peppers, spinach, mushrooms, and feta cheese. Great hot or at room temperature.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 375F. Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet. Saute mushrooms, bell pepper, and onion for 5 minutes. Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Whisk eggs with salt, pepper, and crumbled feta. Pour over the vegetables, gently stirring to distribute.
Cook on medium-low for 3-4 minutes until edges begin to set.
Transfer skillet to the oven and bake for 12-15 minutes until puffed and golden.
Let cool for 5 minutes, then slice into wedges and serve.

recipes.name: Protein Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy pancakes made with Greek yogurt, oats, and eggs for a high-protein twist on the classic. Naturally sweetened with banana.

steps.description: Add rolled oats, Greek yogurt, eggs, banana, and vanilla extract to a blender. Blend until smooth.
Let the batter rest for 5 minutes to thicken slightly.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat with a touch of butter. Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Stack pancakes and top with a drizzle of honey and fresh blueberries.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Egg
recipes.description: Crispy sourdough toast topped with smashed avocado and a perfectly fried egg. Simple, nutritious, and endlessly satisfying.

steps.description: Toast sourdough bread slices until golden and crisp.
Halve the avocado, remove the pit, and mash the flesh with a fork. Season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Heat olive oil in a small skillet and fry the egg sunny-side up until the whites are set but yolk is still runny.
Spread mashed avocado on toast, top with the fried egg, and finish with a pinch of paprika.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Eggs Benedict
recipes.description: Toasted sourdough topped with smoked salmon, poached eggs, and a creamy dill sauce. An elegant brunch centerpiece.

steps.description: Toast sourdough bread slices until golden and crisp.
Mix sour cream with chopped dill, a squeeze of lemon juice, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Bring a pot of water to a gentle simmer with a splash of vinegar. Swirl the water and carefully slide in the eggs. Poach for 3-4 minutes until whites are set.
Place toasted bread on plates. Layer smoked salmon, then a poached egg on each. Drizzle with dill sauce and garnish with capers.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Breakfast Bowl
recipes.description: Roasted sweet potato cubes with scrambled eggs, black beans, and avocado. A colorful, nutrient-dense way to start the day.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 400F. Dice sweet potato into 1cm cubes, toss with olive oil, salt, and paprika. Roast for 20 minutes until tender and caramelized.
While sweet potatoes roast, whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Scramble in a buttered skillet over medium heat until just set.
Heat black beans in a small saucepan with a pinch of cumin until warmed through.
Divide roasted sweet potato between bowls. Add scrambled eggs, black beans, and sliced avocado. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Crisp romaine lettuce with grilled chicken breast, shaved parmesan, and a creamy garlic dressing. A timeless lunch classic.

steps.description: Season chicken breast with salt, pepper, and olive oil. Grill over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through. Let rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Wash and chop romaine lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Pat dry thoroughly.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, Dijon mustard, and grated parmesan until emulsified.
Toss lettuce with dressing, top with sliced chicken and shaved parmesan. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Greek Chicken Bowl
recipes.description: Grilled chicken with quinoa, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, kalamata olives, and feta. A bright Mediterranean lunch bowl.

steps.description: Rinse quinoa and cook in salted water for 15 minutes until fluffy. Fluff with a fork and set aside.
Season chicken with olive oil, salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon. Grill 5-6 minutes per side. Rest and slice.
Dice cucumber and halve cherry tomatoes. Slice kalamata olives and crumble feta cheese.
Divide quinoa between bowls. Arrange chicken, cucumber, tomatoes, olives, and feta on top. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.

recipes.name: Turkey Club Wrap
recipes.description: Sliced turkey breast with avocado, tomato, romaine, and Dijon mustard in a flour tortilla. A quick and protein-packed lunch.

steps.description: Slice the avocado and tomato. Wash and dry romaine lettuce leaves.
Lay the flour tortilla flat and spread Dijon mustard evenly across the surface.
Layer turkey breast, romaine, tomato slices, and avocado down the center of the tortilla.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Cut in half on the diagonal and serve.

recipes.name: Black Bean Burrito Bowl
recipes.description: A deconstructed burrito with seasoned black beans, rice, corn, avocado, and fresh salsa over a bed of romaine. Hearty and plant-forward.

steps.description: Cook white rice according to package directions with a pinch of salt. Fluff with a fork and stir in lime juice and cilantro.
Heat black beans in a saucepan with cumin, paprika, and salt. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Dice the avocado and red onion. Halve cherry tomatoes. Chop romaine lettuce.
Layer chopped romaine, cilantro-lime rice, seasoned beans, corn kernels, tomatoes, red onion, and avocado. Squeeze fresh lime over the top.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Hummus Wrap
recipes.description: A flour tortilla filled with hummus, grilled chicken, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and feta cheese. Fresh, creamy, and satisfying.

steps.description: Season chicken breast with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Grill for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through. Slice thinly.
Slice cucumber and halve cherry tomatoes. Crumble feta cheese.
Spread hummus generously over the flour tortilla. Layer grilled chicken, cucumber, tomatoes, and feta down the center.
Fold in the sides, roll tightly, and slice in half. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Chicken Quesadilla
recipes.description: Crispy flour tortillas filled with seasoned chicken, melted cheddar, and sauteed bell peppers. Served with sour cream on the side.

steps.description: Season chicken breast with cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook in olive oil over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side. Dice into small pieces.
In the same skillet, saute sliced bell pepper and onion for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Lay flour tortillas flat. Layer shredded cheddar, diced chicken, and sauteed peppers on one half. Fold over.
Cook quesadillas in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and cheese is melted. Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream.

recipes.name: Quinoa Mediterranean Bowl
recipes.description: Fluffy quinoa with roasted vegetables, hummus, and kalamata olives. A plant-based lunch packed with fiber and protein.

steps.description: Rinse quinoa and cook in salted water for 15 minutes until fluffy. Fluff with a fork.
Toss diced bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, and red onion with olive oil and salt. Roast at 400F for 20 minutes.
Divide quinoa between bowls. Top with roasted vegetables, a generous scoop of hummus, kalamata olives, and crumbled feta.
Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Cobb Salad
recipes.description: A classic American salad with grilled chicken, hard-boiled eggs, avocado, cherry tomatoes, and crumbled feta over crisp romaine.

steps.description: Season chicken breast with salt, pepper, and olive oil. Grill for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through. Let rest and slice.
Hard-boil eggs, cool, and slice. Dice avocado and halve cherry tomatoes. Crumble feta cheese.
Chop romaine and arrange on a large platter. Line rows of chicken, egg, avocado, tomatoes, and feta across the top.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper. Toss at the table or serve arranged.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese and Tomato
recipes.description: Golden crispy sourdough with melted cheddar and fresh tomato slices. A comforting classic elevated with quality ingredients.

steps.description: Butter the outside of both sourdough slices. Layer cheddar cheese and tomato slices between the bread.
Place sandwich in a skillet over medium-low heat. Cook for 3-4 minutes until the bottom is golden brown.
Carefully flip the sandwich and cook another 3-4 minutes until the second side is golden and cheese is fully melted.
Cut diagonally and serve hot.

recipes.name: Salmon Poke Bowl
recipes.description: Fresh salmon fillet over jasmine rice with cucumber, avocado, and a soy-sesame dressing. A Hawaiian-inspired lunch bowl.

steps.description: Cook jasmine rice according to package directions. Let cool slightly.
Dice salmon fillet into 2cm cubes. Toss with soy sauce and sesame oil. Refrigerate while preparing toppings.
Dice cucumber and avocado. Slice red onion thinly.
Divide rice between bowls. Arrange marinated salmon, cucumber, avocado, and red onion on top. Drizzle with remaining soy-sesame dressing.

recipes.name: Turkey Avocado Sandwich
recipes.description: Stacked sourdough sandwich with sliced turkey, ripe avocado, tomato, and romaine. Simple, clean, and deeply satisfying.

steps.description: Lightly toast sourdough bread slices until golden.
Slice the avocado and tomato. Wash and dry romaine lettuce leaves.
Spread Dijon mustard on one slice. Layer turkey, avocado, tomato, and romaine. Season with salt and pepper and top with the second slice.
Cut in half and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Spinach and Mushroom Quesadilla
recipes.description: Crispy tortilla filled with sauteed spinach, mushrooms, and melted mozzarella. A vegetarian lunch that delivers on flavor.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a skillet. Saute sliced mushrooms for 4 minutes until golden. Add spinach and garlic, cooking until wilted.
Lay a flour tortilla flat. Spread sauteed vegetables and shredded mozzarella over one half.
Fold tortilla in half and cook in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and cheese is melted.
Cut into wedges and serve hot with a side of sour cream.

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.description: Breaded chicken breast topped with marinara sauce and melted mozzarella. A beloved Italian-American dinner served over spaghetti.

steps.description: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness. Dredge in flour, dip in beaten egg, then coat in a mixture of breadcrumbs and grated parmesan.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook breaded chicken for 4-5 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Spoon marinara sauce over each chicken breast. Top with sliced mozzarella. Cover and cook for 3-4 minutes until cheese melts.
Meanwhile, cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and toss with a bit of olive oil.
Plate spaghetti and top with chicken parmesan. Garnish with fresh basil.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Tender strips of beef with crisp broccoli in a savory soy-ginger sauce. A quick weeknight dinner served over steamed rice.

steps.description: Whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, minced garlic, and grated ginger in a small bowl.
Heat olive oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Sear ground beef, breaking it into strips, for 3-4 minutes until browned. Remove and set aside.
In the same wok, stir-fry broccoli florets for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp. Add sliced onion and cook 1 more minute.
Return beef to the wok, pour sauce over everything, and toss to coat. Serve immediately over steamed white rice.

recipes.name: Fish Tacos
recipes.description: Flaky seasoned fish in warm corn tortillas with crunchy slaw and a creamy lime drizzle. Light, bright, and full of texture.

steps.description: Pat salmon fillets dry and season with cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook fish for 3-4 minutes per side until flaky. Break into large chunks.
Toss shredded romaine with sour cream, lime juice, and chopped cilantro.
Heat corn tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Fill tortillas with fish chunks and top with slaw and sliced avocado.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Salmon
recipes.description: Pan-seared salmon glazed with a sweet and savory soy-ginger teriyaki sauce. Served over jasmine rice with steamed broccoli.

steps.description: Whisk together soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, grated ginger, and minced garlic in a small bowl.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear salmon fillets skin-side up for 4 minutes. Flip and cook 3 more minutes.
Pour teriyaki sauce over the salmon. Let it bubble and reduce for 2 minutes, basting the fish.
Serve glazed salmon over steamed jasmine rice with broccoli on the side.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.description: Rich and hearty beef ragu simmered with tomatoes, onion, and garlic over al dente spaghetti. A family dinner staple.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Add ground beef and cook over high heat for 5 minutes, breaking it up until well browned. Remove and set aside.
In the same pot, saute diced onion, carrots, celery, and garlic for 5 minutes until softened.
Return beef to the pot. Add marinara sauce, salt, and pepper. Simmer on low for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and divide among plates. Ladle bolognese sauce over the top and finish with grated parmesan.

recipes.name: Coconut Curry Shrimp
recipes.description: Plump shrimp simmered in a fragrant coconut milk curry with bell peppers and spinach. Served over jasmine rice.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large skillet. Saute diced onion, garlic, and ginger for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add curry powder, diced bell pepper, and cook for 2 minutes. Pour in coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add shrimp and spinach to the curry. Cook for 4-5 minutes until shrimp are pink and curled. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve the curry over steamed jasmine rice, garnished with fresh cilantro.

recipes.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.description: Bell peppers filled with a savory mixture of ground beef, rice, tomatoes, and melted cheese. A colorful and complete one-dish dinner.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 375F. Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds. Place upright in a baking dish.
Brown ground beef with diced onion and garlic. Add cooked rice, diced tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Fill each pepper with the beef-rice mixture. Top with shredded cheddar cheese. Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove foil and bake 10 more minutes until cheese is bubbly and golden. Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
recipes.description: Succulent shrimp tossed with spaghetti in a rich garlic butter sauce with lemon and fresh basil. Ready in under 20 minutes.

steps.description: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, saute minced garlic for 30 seconds. Add lemon juice and pasta water. Simmer for 2 minutes.
Toss drained pasta and shrimp in the garlic butter sauce. Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with fresh basil and parmesan.

recipes.name: Herb-Roasted Pork Tenderloin
recipes.description: Juicy pork tenderloin roasted with fresh rosemary, thyme, and Dijon mustard. Served with roasted sweet potatoes.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 400F. Pat pork tenderloin dry. Rub with Dijon mustard, olive oil, chopped rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Heat a skillet over high heat. Sear pork on all sides for 2 minutes total until browned.
Place seared pork on a sheet pan with diced sweet potatoes tossed in olive oil and salt. Roast for 25 minutes until pork reaches 145F internally.
Let pork rest for 10 minutes, then slice into medallions. Serve alongside roasted sweet potatoes.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Creamy arborio rice slowly cooked with mushrooms, white wine, and parmesan cheese. A luxurious Italian comfort dish.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large pan. Saute sliced mushrooms for 5 minutes until golden. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, saute diced onion until soft. Add arborio rice and stir for 2 minutes until translucent. Add white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add warm vegetable broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly. Wait for each addition to be absorbed before adding more. Continue for 18-20 minutes.
Stir in mushrooms, butter, and grated parmesan. Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately while creamy.

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Roasted Chicken
recipes.description: Bone-in chicken breast roasted with lemon, fresh thyme, rosemary, and garlic. Juicy, aromatic, and perfectly golden.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 425F. Pat chicken breasts dry. Rub with olive oil, salt, pepper, chopped thyme, and rosemary.
Slice lemon and arrange around the chicken in a roasting pan. Scatter garlic cloves around the pan.
Roast for 30-35 minutes until chicken reaches 165F internally and skin is golden and crispy.
Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing. Serve with pan juices spooned over the top and roasted asparagus.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Tender chicken pieces in a creamy, spiced tomato sauce. A rich and aromatic curry served with jasmine rice.

steps.description: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Season with curry powder, salt, and pepper. Cook in olive oil over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes until browned. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, saute diced onion and garlic for 3 minutes. Add curry powder, paprika, and diced tomatoes. Cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and return chicken to the pan. Simmer for 12-15 minutes until the sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through.
Serve the curry over steamed jasmine rice, garnished with fresh cilantro.

recipes.name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Asparagus
recipes.description: Crispy-skinned salmon served alongside roasted asparagus with a bright lemon-dill sauce. An elegant yet simple dinner.

steps.description: Toss asparagus with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast at 400F for 12 minutes until tender-crisp.
Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook skin-side down for 4 minutes, then flip and cook 3 more minutes.
In a small bowl, mix sour cream with chopped dill, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Plate salmon alongside roasted asparagus. Drizzle with the lemon-dill sauce and garnish with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: BBQ Chicken with Sweet Potato
recipes.description: Juicy chicken breast glazed with a smoky BBQ sauce and served with roasted sweet potato wedges. A crowd-pleasing dinner.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 400F. Cut sweet potatoes into wedges. Toss with olive oil, paprika, and salt. Spread on a sheet pan.
Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and paprika. Place on the sheet pan with the sweet potatoes.
Roast for 20 minutes. Remove and brush chicken generously with a mixture of honey and Dijon mustard as a BBQ glaze.
Return to oven for 10 more minutes until chicken is cooked through and glaze is caramelized. Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Chicken Marsala
recipes.description: Pan-seared chicken in a rich marsala wine and mushroom sauce. A classic Italian-American dinner that feels restaurant-worthy.

steps.description: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness. Season with salt and pepper and lightly dredge in flour.
Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet. Cook chicken for 4-5 minutes per side until golden. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, saute sliced mushrooms for 4 minutes. Add white wine and scrape up browned bits. Simmer for 3 minutes. Add vegetable broth and thyme, simmering 5 more minutes.
Return chicken to the pan, spooning sauce over the top. Cook 2 more minutes until chicken is heated through. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Beef Meatloaf
recipes.description: A classic homestyle meatloaf with a tangy glaze. Comfort food at its finest, served with a side of roasted carrots.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 375F. In a large bowl, combine ground beef, beaten egg, diced onion, minced garlic, rolled oats, salt, and pepper. Mix until just combined.
Form the mixture into a loaf shape on a sheet pan. Brush the top with a mixture of Dijon mustard and honey.
Arrange diced carrots around the meatloaf. Bake for 40-45 minutes until internal temperature reaches 160F.
Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing. Serve with the roasted carrots.

recipes.name: Chicken Piccata
recipes.description: Pan-seared chicken in a bright lemon-caper butter sauce. Light, tangy, and elegant enough for a dinner party.

steps.description: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness. Season with salt and pepper and lightly dredge in flour.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, add butter, white wine, lemon juice, and capers. Simmer for 3-4 minutes until slightly reduced.
Return chicken to the pan and spoon sauce over the top. Cook 2 more minutes. Serve garnished with fresh basil.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Mushroom Sauce
recipes.description: Seared pork tenderloin medallions in a creamy mushroom and thyme sauce. Rich, savory, and deeply satisfying.

steps.description: Slice pork tenderloin into 2cm thick medallions. Season with salt and pepper. Sear in olive oil over high heat for 3 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add sliced mushrooms and cook for 4-5 minutes until golden and softened.
Add garlic and thyme, cooking 30 seconds. Pour in vegetable broth and heavy cream. Simmer for 5 minutes until reduced.
Return pork to the pan, spooning sauce over each medallion. Cook 2 more minutes. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Caprese Stuffed Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken breast stuffed with fresh mozzarella, tomato, and basil, then baked until golden. A fresh Italian-inspired dinner.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 400F. Cut a deep pocket horizontally into each chicken breast, being careful not to cut all the way through.
Fill each pocket with sliced fresh mozzarella, tomato slices, and fresh basil leaves. Secure with toothpicks if needed.
Season stuffed chicken with salt and pepper. Sear in olive oil for 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove toothpicks. Drizzle with balsamic glaze and serve with a side salad.

recipes.name: Shrimp Stir-Fry with Vegetables
recipes.description: Quick-cooked shrimp with broccoli, bell peppers, and carrots in a savory soy-ginger sauce over steamed rice.

steps.description: Whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, and grated ginger in a small bowl.
Heat olive oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry broccoli, bell pepper, and carrots for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Push vegetables to the side. Add shrimp and cook for 2 minutes per side until pink. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds more.
Pour sauce over everything and toss to coat. Serve immediately over steamed jasmine rice.

recipes.name: Steamed Jasmine Rice
recipes.description: Fragrant jasmine rice steamed to fluffy perfection. A versatile side that pairs beautifully with curries, stir-fries, and braised dishes.

steps.description: Place jasmine rice in a fine-mesh strainer and rinse under cold running water until the water runs clear, about 1-2 minutes.
Combine the rinsed rice and water in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and let the rice steam with the lid on for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork, season with salt, and serve.

recipes.name: Cilantro Lime Rice
recipes.description: Bright and zesty rice tossed with fresh cilantro and lime juice. A vibrant side dish inspired by the flavors of Mexican cuisine.

steps.description: Rinse white rice under cold water until clear. Combine with water and salt in a saucepan, bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 18 minutes.
While the rice cooks, finely chop the fresh cilantro and juice the lime.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork. Stir in the olive oil, lime juice, and chopped cilantro. Season with additional salt to taste and serve warm.

recipes.name: Butter Noodles
recipes.description: Simple egg noodles tossed in melted butter with a sprinkle of parmesan. A comforting classic side dish that complements almost any protein.

steps.description: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti according to package directions until al dente. Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water before draining.
Return the drained pasta to the pot. Add the butter and toss until it melts and coats every strand. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if needed.
Season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese, and serve immediately while hot.

recipes.name: Roasted Sweet Potatoes
recipes.description: Cubed sweet potatoes roasted until caramelized and tender with a hint of cumin and paprika. A naturally sweet and nutritious side.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into 3/4-inch cubes.
Toss the cubes with olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Spread in a single layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Roast for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the edges are golden and caramelized. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Garlic Bread
recipes.description: Crusty sourdough bread slathered with garlic butter and toasted until golden. An irresistible accompaniment to pasta, soups, and stews.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. In a small bowl, mash together softened butter, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt until well combined.
Slice the sourdough bread in half lengthwise. Spread the garlic butter mixture generously and evenly over the cut surfaces.
Place the bread halves cut-side up on a baking sheet. Bake for 8-10 minutes until the edges are golden and the butter is bubbling. Slice into portions and serve hot.

recipes.name: Fried Rice
recipes.description: Quick stir-fried rice with vegetables, egg, soy sauce, and sesame oil. A savory side that transforms leftover rice into something special.

steps.description: Heat sesame oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat. Crack in the eggs and scramble quickly, breaking them into small pieces. Remove and set aside.
Add olive oil to the wok. Saute diced carrots and minced garlic for 2 minutes until slightly softened.
Add the cooked rice to the wok, breaking up any clumps. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until the rice is hot and slightly crispy. Drizzle with soy sauce and toss to combine.
Return the scrambled egg to the wok and toss everything together. Season with salt and pepper, and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Quinoa Tabbouleh
recipes.description: A protein-rich twist on the classic Middle Eastern salad using quinoa instead of bulgur, with fresh herbs, cucumber, and lemon.

steps.description: Rinse quinoa under cold water. Combine with water in a saucepan, bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until water is absorbed. Fluff and let cool.
Dice the cucumber into small cubes. Finely chop the fresh cilantro. Juice the lemon.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled quinoa, cucumber, and cilantro. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, season with salt, and toss gently to combine.
Let the tabbouleh rest for 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

recipes.name: Rice Pilaf
recipes.description: Aromatic white rice toasted in butter with onions and vegetable broth. A classic side dish with depth of flavor from the toasting step.

steps.description: Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add diced onion and cook for 3 minutes until softened. Add the rice and stir for 2 minutes until lightly toasted and fragrant.
Pour in the vegetable broth and season with salt and thyme. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes without lifting the lid.
Remove from heat and let rest covered for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and serve warm.

recipes.name: Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: Creamy stovetop macaroni and cheese made with sharp cheddar and a touch of cream. Pure comfort food ready in under 20 minutes.

steps.description: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the spaghetti (or elbow macaroni) until al dente according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
In the same pot, melt butter over medium heat. Stir in the heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer. Add the shredded cheddar cheese in handfuls, stirring until each addition is melted and smooth.
Add the cooked pasta back to the cheese sauce and stir until every piece is coated. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide among bowls and serve immediately while hot and creamy.

recipes.name: Pasta Primavera
recipes.description: Spaghetti tossed with sauteed seasonal vegetables in a light olive oil and garlic sauce. A colorful and wholesome pasta side.

steps.description: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add sliced bell pepper, broccoli florets, and minced garlic. Saute for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add the drained pasta to the skillet with the vegetables. Toss together, adding a splash of pasta water to loosen. Season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon.
Divide among plates and top with grated parmesan cheese. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Herb Roasted Potatoes
recipes.description: Baby potatoes roasted with rosemary, thyme, and garlic until crispy on the outside and creamy inside. A crowd-pleasing dinner side.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Wash and halve the sweet potatoes (or regular potatoes). Pat dry thoroughly with paper towels.
Toss the potatoes with olive oil, minced garlic, chopped rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper in a large bowl until evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes cut-side down in a single layer on a baking sheet. Roast for 30-35 minutes, flipping once halfway through, until golden and fork-tender.

recipes.name: Coconut Rice
recipes.description: Rich and fragrant jasmine rice simmered in coconut milk with a touch of salt. A tropical side that pairs wonderfully with curries and grilled meats.

steps.description: Rinse jasmine rice under cold water until clear. In a medium saucepan, combine the rice, coconut milk, water, and salt.
Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 18 minutes without lifting the lid.
Remove from heat and let stand covered for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork, sprinkle with coconut flakes if desired, and serve.

recipes.name: Spanish Rice
recipes.description: Savory tomato-infused rice with onion, garlic, and cumin. A bold and colorful side dish that brings Mexican-inspired flavor to any meal.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add diced onion and minced garlic, cooking for 3 minutes until softened and fragrant.
Add the rice and stir for 2 minutes until lightly toasted. Add diced tomato, vegetable broth, cumin, and salt. Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Fluff with a fork and stir in fresh cilantro. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Quinoa
recipes.description: Fluffy quinoa brightened with lemon zest, fresh thyme, and a drizzle of olive oil. A light and nutritious alternative to rice.

steps.description: Rinse quinoa thoroughly under cold water. Combine with water and salt in a saucepan, bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until water is absorbed.
Fluff the quinoa with a fork. Stir in the olive oil, lemon juice, and chopped thyme. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with lemon zest. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Cornbread
recipes.description: Golden, slightly sweet cornbread baked until perfectly moist inside with a crispy crust. A Southern staple that pairs with chili, barbecue, or stew.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Grease an 8-inch square baking pan. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined. Do not overmix — a few lumps are fine.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden on top and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let cool in the pan for 5 minutes before slicing into squares. Serve warm with butter if desired.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Creamy arborio rice slowly simmered with cremini mushrooms, white wine, and parmesan. An elegant Italian side worth the stirring.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-high heat. Add sliced cremini mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes until golden. Add minced garlic and cook 1 minute more. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, melt butter and add the arborio rice. Stir for 2 minutes until the grains are translucent at the edges. Pour in the white wine and stir until absorbed.

Add warm vegetable broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting for each addition to be absorbed before adding the next. Continue for 18-20 minutes until the rice is creamy and al dente.
Stir in the sauteed mushrooms and parmesan cheese. Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately in warm bowls.

recipes.name: Baked Sweet Potato
recipes.description: Whole sweet potatoes baked until the flesh is soft and caramelized. A simple, naturally sweet starch served with a pat of butter.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Scrub the sweet potatoes clean and poke several holes in each one with a fork. Rub lightly with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Place the sweet potatoes directly on the oven rack with a baking sheet on the rack below to catch drips. Bake for 45-50 minutes until easily pierced with a knife.
Slice each sweet potato open lengthwise and fluff the inside with a fork. Top with a pat of butter and a sprinkle of cinnamon. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Orzo Salad
recipes.description: Chilled orzo pasta tossed with cherry tomatoes, cucumber, kalamata olives, and feta in a lemon vinaigrette. A refreshing Mediterranean side.

steps.description: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the spaghetti (or orzo pasta) until al dente. Drain and rinse under cold water to stop cooking. Toss with a drizzle of olive oil to prevent sticking.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the cucumber, and crumble the feta cheese.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled pasta, tomatoes, cucumber, olives, and feta. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss gently.
Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes to let the flavors marry. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Oatmeal with Honey and Almonds
recipes.description: Creamy stovetop oatmeal drizzled with honey and topped with toasted almonds. A warm, hearty starch that works as a side or base for savory toppings.

steps.description: Combine rolled oats, milk, and a pinch of salt in a small saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally, and cook for 5-7 minutes until thick and creamy.
Divide the oatmeal between two bowls. Drizzle each with honey and scatter chopped almonds over the top. Serve hot.

recipes.name: Black Bean and Corn Rice
recipes.description: Hearty white rice studded with black beans, corn kernels, and a squeeze of lime. A Southwestern-inspired side that adds protein and fiber to any plate.

steps.description: Rinse white rice under cold water. Combine with water and salt in a saucepan, bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 18 minutes.
While the rice cooks, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the black beans and corn kernels, stirring for 3-4 minutes until warmed through.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and add it to the skillet with the beans and corn. Stir in cumin and lime juice. Toss to combine and season with salt.
Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with fresh cilantro. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Crisp romaine lettuce tossed with a garlicky lemon-parmesan dressing and crunchy crouton-style sourdough crumbles. A timeless side salad.

steps.description: In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper until emulsified.
Cut sourdough bread into small cubes. Toss with a drizzle of olive oil, spread on a baking sheet, and bake at 400°F for 5 minutes until golden and crisp.
Chop the romaine lettuce into bite-size pieces and place in a large bowl. Drizzle with dressing, toss to coat, then top with toasted bread cubes and shaved parmesan.

recipes.name: Greek Salad
recipes.description: A classic Mediterranean salad with juicy tomatoes, crisp cucumber, red onion, kalamata olives, and tangy feta cheese in a simple olive oil dressing.

steps.description: Dice the cucumber and tomatoes into bite-size chunks. Thinly slice the red onion. Halve or leave the kalamata olives whole.
Whisk together olive oil, a squeeze of lemon juice, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl.
Combine all the vegetables in a large bowl. Crumble feta cheese over the top. Drizzle with dressing and toss gently. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Roasted Broccoli
recipes.description: Tender broccoli florets roasted at high heat with garlic and olive oil until caramelized and slightly crispy at the edges.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 425°F. Cut broccoli into even-sized florets. Toss with olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper on a large baking sheet.
Spread broccoli in a single layer and roast for 18-20 minutes, flipping halfway through, until edges are golden and slightly charred.
Remove from oven and squeeze fresh lemon juice over the top. Serve immediately as a side dish.

recipes.name: Sauteed Spinach
recipes.description: Fresh baby spinach quickly wilted with garlic and a splash of olive oil. A simple, nutritious side that comes together in under five minutes.

steps.description: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add all the baby spinach at once, using tongs to toss and turn it as it wilts down, about 2-3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the spinach, toss once more, and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Coleslaw
recipes.description: A creamy, tangy coleslaw with shredded carrots and a honey-Dijon dressing. Crunchy and refreshing, perfect alongside grilled meats.

steps.description: In a small bowl, whisk together sour cream, Dijon mustard, honey, salt, and black pepper until smooth.
Peel and shred the carrots. Core the cabbage equivalent using romaine lettuce, shredding it finely.
Combine the shredded lettuce and carrots in a large bowl. Pour the dressing over and toss until evenly coated. Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes before serving to let flavors meld.

recipes.name: Grilled Asparagus
recipes.description: Tender asparagus spears grilled until lightly charred and seasoned with olive oil, garlic, and fresh lemon. Elegant simplicity at its best.

steps.description: Trim the woody ends from the asparagus spears. Toss with olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Place asparagus on a preheated grill or grill pan over medium-high heat. Grill for 3-4 minutes per side until tender with light char marks.
Transfer to a serving platter and squeeze fresh lemon juice over the top. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Roasted Carrots
recipes.description: Sweet carrots roasted with honey, fresh thyme, and a hint of cinnamon until caramelized and fork-tender. A comforting and colorful side.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 400°F. Peel and cut carrots into even sticks or diagonal slices. Toss with olive oil, honey, fresh thyme leaves, salt, and a pinch of cinnamon.
Spread carrots in a single layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Roast for 20-25 minutes, turning once, until tender and caramelized at the edges.

recipes.name: Steamed Broccoli with Lemon
recipes.description: Bright green broccoli florets steamed until just tender, finished with a squeeze of lemon and a drizzle of olive oil. Clean, simple, and healthy.

steps.description: Bring an inch of water to a boil in a pot with a steamer basket. Add broccoli florets, cover, and steam for 5-6 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Transfer broccoli to a serving bowl. Drizzle with olive oil, squeeze lemon juice over the top, and season with salt and pepper. Toss gently and serve.

recipes.name: Garden Salad
recipes.description: A light and refreshing mix of romaine lettuce, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion with a simple olive oil and lemon dressing.

steps.description: Wash and chop the romaine lettuce. Halve the cherry tomatoes. Slice the cucumber into half-moons. Thinly slice the red onion.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Combine all vegetables in a large bowl, drizzle with dressing, and toss gently. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Cucumber Tomato Salad
recipes.description: A cool and refreshing salad of crisp cucumber and ripe tomatoes tossed with red onion, fresh basil, and a tangy balsamic drizzle.

steps.description: Dice the cucumbers and tomatoes into bite-size pieces. Thinly slice the red onion. Tear fresh basil leaves.
In a large bowl, combine the vegetables and basil. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze. Season with salt and pepper, then toss gently.
Let sit for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld, then serve at room temperature.

recipes.name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts
recipes.description: Brussels sprouts halved and roasted until deeply caramelized, finished with a drizzle of balsamic glaze. Crispy outside, tender inside.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 425°F. Trim and halve the Brussels sprouts (using broccoli florets as a substitute base). Toss with olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Spread cut-side down on a baking sheet in a single layer. Roast for 20-25 minutes until deeply golden and crispy on the edges.
Transfer to a serving dish and drizzle with balsamic glaze. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Garlic Green Beans
recipes.description: Crisp-tender green beans sauteed with plenty of garlic and finished with a squeeze of lemon. A quick and flavorful side dish.

steps.description: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add trimmed asparagus spears and cook for 2 minutes. Drain and plunge into ice water to stop cooking.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the blanched beans and saute for 4-5 minutes until heated through and slightly blistered.
Season with salt and pepper, squeeze lemon juice over the top, and serve warm.

recipes.name: Grilled Zucchini
recipes.description: Thick slices of zucchini grilled until tender with beautiful char marks, seasoned with olive oil, garlic, and fresh herbs.

steps.description: Slice the cucumber lengthwise into 1/4-inch thick planks. Brush both sides with olive oil and season with minced garlic, salt, and pepper.
Place on a preheated grill or grill pan over medium-high heat. Grill for 3-4 minutes per side until tender with nice grill marks.
Transfer to a platter, drizzle with a touch more olive oil, and garnish with fresh basil. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Salad
recipes.description: A vibrant salad with quinoa, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, kalamata olives, and feta dressed in a bright lemon-olive oil vinaigrette.

steps.description: Rinse quinoa under cold water. Combine with 2 cups water in a saucepan, bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes. Fluff with a fork and let cool.
Halve the cherry tomatoes. Dice the cucumber. Slice the olives. Crumble the feta cheese.
In a large bowl, combine the cooled quinoa with all the vegetables and feta. Drizzle with olive oil, squeeze lemon juice over the top, season with salt and pepper, and toss gently.
Serve at room temperature or chilled. This salad holds well for meal prep.

recipes.name: Avocado Salad
recipes.description: Creamy avocado chunks tossed with cherry tomatoes, red onion, and fresh cilantro in a zesty lime dressing. Rich, fresh, and satisfying.

steps.description: Halve and pit the avocados, then cut into chunks. Halve the cherry tomatoes. Thinly slice the red onion. Chop the cilantro.
Squeeze lime juice into a small bowl. Add olive oil, salt, and pepper and whisk to combine.
Gently combine avocado, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and cilantro in a bowl. Drizzle with lime dressing and toss carefully to avoid mashing the avocado. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Trail Mix
recipes.description: A crunchy and satisfying mix of almonds, dark chocolate chips, coconut flakes, and rolled oats. Perfect for on-the-go snacking.

steps.description: In a large bowl, toss together almonds, dark chocolate chips, coconut flakes, and rolled oats until evenly mixed.
Divide into individual portions or store in an airtight container for up to two weeks.

recipes.name: Yogurt Parfait
recipes.description: Layers of creamy Greek yogurt, crunchy granola, fresh blueberries, and a drizzle of honey. A beautiful and balanced snack.

steps.description: In a glass or bowl, spoon a layer of Greek yogurt, then granola, then blueberries. Repeat layers once more.
Drizzle honey over the top and serve immediately for maximum crunch.

recipes.name: Cheese and Crackers
recipes.description: Sharp cheddar cheese paired with crispy crackers and a dab of Dijon mustard. A classic, no-fuss snack that never disappoints.

steps.description: Cut the cheddar cheese into thin slices or small cubes that fit neatly on the crackers.
Arrange crackers on a plate, top each with a slice of cheese and a small dab of Dijon mustard. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Fruit and Nut Bars
recipes.description: Chewy homemade bars packed with dates, almonds, rolled oats, and dark chocolate chips. A wholesome energy bar with no added sugar.

steps.description: Add pitted Medjool dates to a food processor and pulse until they form a sticky paste. Add almonds and pulse until roughly chopped and combined.
Transfer to a bowl and mix in rolled oats, dark chocolate chips, and a pinch of salt. Press the mixture firmly into a parchment-lined 8x8 baking dish.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour until firm. Cut into 8 bars and store in the refrigerator.

recipes.name: Berry Smoothie
recipes.description: A thick and creamy smoothie blended with frozen blueberries, banana, Greek yogurt, and a splash of milk. Naturally sweet and refreshing.

steps.description: Add blueberries, banana, Greek yogurt, and milk to a blender. Blend on high until completely smooth and creamy, about 1 minute.
Pour into a tall glass and serve immediately while cold.

recipes.name: Banana Bread Bites
recipes.description: Moist and tender mini banana bread bites made with ripe bananas, rolled oats, and a touch of cinnamon. A portable, guilt-free treat.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 350°F. Mash the bananas in a bowl. Stir in rolled oats, egg, honey, vanilla extract, and cinnamon until well combined.
Spoon the batter into a greased mini muffin tin, filling each cup about 3/4 full. Bake for 12-15 minutes until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Protein Balls
recipes.description: No-bake energy balls made with peanut butter, rolled oats, honey, and dark chocolate chips. A perfect pre- or post-workout snack.

steps.description: In a large bowl, combine peanut butter, rolled oats, honey, and dark chocolate chips. Stir until a thick, sticky dough forms.
Roll tablespoon-sized portions into balls with your hands. Place on a parchment-lined tray and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes until firm.

recipes.name: Veggie Sticks with Hummus
recipes.description: Crunchy carrot and celery sticks served with a generous scoop of creamy hummus. A simple, healthy snack that is always satisfying.

steps.description: Peel and cut carrots into sticks. Wash and cut celery into sticks of similar length.
Scoop hummus into a small bowl in the center of a plate. Arrange the carrot and celery sticks around the hummus for dipping.

recipes.name: Ants on a Log
recipes.description: Celery sticks filled with peanut butter and topped with sweet raisins (dark chocolate chips as a substitute). A fun and wholesome snack loved by all ages.

steps.description: Wash and cut celery stalks into 4-inch pieces. Fill the groove of each piece with peanut butter.
Press dark chocolate chips into the peanut butter along the length of each celery stick. Arrange on a plate and serve.

recipes.name: Granola Bars
recipes.description: Chewy homemade granola bars with oats, honey, peanut butter, and chocolate chips. Wholesome, portable, and far better than store-bought.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 325°F. In a large bowl, combine rolled oats, honey, peanut butter, and a pinch of salt. Stir until everything is well coated. Fold in dark chocolate chips.
Press the mixture firmly and evenly into a parchment-lined 9x13 baking pan. Bake for 18-20 minutes until the edges turn golden.
Let cool completely in the pan before cutting into 10 bars. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.name: Apple Nachos
recipes.description: Thinly sliced apples drizzled with peanut butter, honey, and sprinkled with granola and chocolate chips. A sweet, crunchy, and shareable snack.

steps.description: Core and thinly slice the apples. Spread them out on a large plate in a single layer, nacho-style.
Drizzle peanut butter and honey over the apple slices. Sprinkle with granola and dark chocolate chips. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Bowl
recipes.description: Creamy Greek yogurt topped with fresh blueberries, sliced banana, chia seeds, and a drizzle of honey. Light, protein-rich, and refreshing.

steps.description: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl. Top with sliced banana, blueberries, and chia seeds.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Rice Cakes with Toppings
recipes.description: Light and crispy rice cakes topped with peanut butter, sliced banana, and a drizzle of honey. A quick snack with a satisfying crunch.

steps.description: Spread peanut butter evenly over each rice cake (using crackers as the base). Top with sliced banana rounds.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Popcorn Mix
recipes.description: Light popcorn (using rolled oats as a base) tossed with melted butter, parmesan cheese, and a sprinkle of paprika. A savory, crunchy snack.

steps.description: In a dry skillet over medium heat, toast rolled oats for 3-4 minutes, stirring frequently, until golden and fragrant.
Drizzle melted butter over the toasted oats. Sprinkle with grated parmesan and paprika. Toss until evenly coated and serve warm.

recipes.name: Frozen Yogurt Bark
recipes.description: Greek yogurt spread thin, studded with blueberries, dark chocolate chips, and coconut flakes, then frozen and broken into bark pieces. A cool, creamy treat.

steps.description: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread Greek yogurt evenly into a thin layer, about 1/4 inch thick. Scatter blueberries, dark chocolate chips, and coconut flakes over the top, pressing gently.
Place in the freezer for at least 2 hours until completely frozen. Break into irregular bark pieces and serve immediately. Store leftover pieces in the freezer.

recipes.name: Chocolate Mousse
recipes.description: A rich and velvety chocolate mousse made with melted dark chocolate and whipped cream. Elegant, indulgent, and surprisingly simple.

steps.description: Place dark chocolate chips in a heatproof bowl over a pot of simmering water. Stir gently until completely melted and smooth. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
In a chilled bowl, whip the heavy cream with vanilla extract until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold one-third of the whipped cream into the melted chocolate to lighten it. Then fold in the remaining whipped cream in two additions, being careful not to deflate it.
Divide the mousse among four serving glasses or ramekins. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours until set. Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Fruit Tart
recipes.description: A buttery tart shell filled with vanilla cream and topped with fresh blueberries and sliced banana. Beautiful, bright, and deliciously light.

steps.description: Combine flour, butter, sugar, and a pinch of salt in a food processor. Pulse until crumbly. Press into a tart pan and bake at 375°F for 12-15 minutes until golden. Let cool completely.
Whisk together cream cheese and honey until smooth. Spread evenly over the cooled tart shell.
Arrange sliced banana and fresh blueberries over the cream in a decorative pattern.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes to set, then slice and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Panna Cotta
recipes.description: A silky Italian custard made with heavy cream, vanilla, and a touch of honey. Delicate, creamy, and utterly elegant.

steps.description: In a saucepan over medium heat, combine heavy cream, whole milk, honey, and vanilla extract. Heat until just simmering, stirring to dissolve the honey. Do not boil.
Remove from heat. Pour the warm cream mixture into four ramekins or small glasses.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight until firmly set.
Serve chilled in the ramekins, optionally topped with fresh blueberries.

recipes.name: Banana Ice Cream
recipes.description: A one-ingredient wonder: frozen bananas blended until impossibly creamy, with optional chocolate chips folded in. Healthy, dairy-free, and delicious.

steps.description: Add frozen banana pieces to a food processor or high-speed blender. Process for 3-4 minutes, scraping down the sides as needed, until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy like soft-serve ice cream.
Fold in dark chocolate chips and a splash of vanilla extract.
Serve immediately for soft-serve consistency, or freeze for 1 hour for a firmer scoop.

recipes.name: Berry Crumble
recipes.description: Sweet blueberries baked under a golden, buttery oat crumble topping. Warm, fruity, and perfect with a scoop of yogurt.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 375°F. Toss blueberries with a tablespoon of sugar and a squeeze of lemon juice. Spread in a baking dish.
In a bowl, combine rolled oats, flour, sugar, and cinnamon. Cut in cold butter with your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Scatter the crumble topping evenly over the berries. Bake for 25-30 minutes until the topping is golden and the filling is bubbling.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving. Delicious on its own or with a dollop of Greek yogurt.

recipes.name: Lemon Bars
recipes.description: A buttery shortbread crust topped with a bright and tangy lemon curd filling. Sweet, tart, and absolutely irresistible.

steps.description: Preheat oven to 350°F. Mix flour, butter, and 2 tablespoons of sugar until crumbly. Press firmly into the bottom of a greased 8x8 baking pan. Bake for 15 minutes until lightly golden.
While the crust bakes, whisk together eggs, remaining sugar, lemon juice, lemon zest, and a tablespoon of flour until smooth.
Pour the lemon filling over the hot crust. Return to the oven and bake for 18-20 minutes until the filling is just set and no longer jiggles.
Let cool completely in the pan, then refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Cut into 9 squares and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Classic golden-brown cookies with a soft, chewy center and melty pools of dark chocolate. The ultimate comfort dessert.

steps.description: Cream together softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract. In a separate bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, and salt. Gradually mix the dry ingredients into the wet until just combined. Fold in dark chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto parchment-lined baking sheets, spacing them 2 inches apart.
Bake at 350°F for 10-12 minutes until the edges are golden but the centers still look slightly underdone. They will firm up as they cool.
Let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.name: Rice Pudding
recipes.description: Creamy, comforting rice pudding slow-cooked with milk, vanilla, and a touch of cinnamon. A nostalgic dessert that warms the soul.

steps.description: In a saucepan, combine cooked white rice, whole milk, sugar, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium-low heat.
Cook for 25-30 minutes, stirring frequently, until the mixture thickens and becomes creamy. The rice should be very tender.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract and ground cinnamon. Serve warm or chilled, sprinkled with a dusting of cinnamon on top.

recipes.name: Tiramisu
recipes.description: A simplified tiramisu with layers of cream cheese filling and soaked sourdough bread, dusted with dark chocolate. Rich, coffee-free, and indulgent.

steps.description: Beat together cream cheese, heavy cream, sugar, and vanilla extract until thick and fluffy.
Slice sourdough bread thinly. Briefly dip each slice in milk to soften slightly without making it soggy.
In a dish, layer the soaked bread slices and cream filling, repeating until all ingredients are used, finishing with a cream layer.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight. Before serving, finely grate dark chocolate over the top.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Sugar Churros
recipes.description: Crispy fried dough sticks coated in a generous layer of cinnamon sugar. Golden, warm, and utterly addictive.

steps.description: In a saucepan, bring 1 cup water, butter, sugar, and a pinch of salt to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in flour vigorously until a smooth dough forms. Beat in the egg until fully incorporated.
Transfer the dough to a piping bag with a star tip. Pipe 4-inch strips into hot oil (375°F) and fry for 2-3 minutes per side until deep golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
Mix granulated sugar and ground cinnamon together on a plate. Roll the warm churros in the cinnamon sugar until fully coated.
Serve warm while still crispy. Optionally dip in melted chocolate.
